🥨 Thanks for swinging by! I'm Kath, a twentysomething muddling thru life near Chicago. On the channel, I share video diaries, way too many precious moments with my bunny Luna, tips for (future) bun parents, and anything else I feel like filming.

🦦 Come along for the ride :)
